title: Warm Embrace
description: Mixed-media painting showing a tender, comforting embrace. Bold dark tones and warm orange, peach, and gray brushstrokes create a feeling of closeness, care, and protection.
warmWords: Sometimes the biggest comfort comes from simply being held and knowing you are not alone. I hope this painting reminds you that you are cared for, loved, and surrounded by warmth. Keep going, keep believing, and remember that brighter days are always ahead.

title: Sunshine Hearts
description: A bright, playful painting made by Maya to remind little patients that every day can feel like a sunny day.
warmWords: Hello! I painted this for you because I know sometimes days can feel cloudy, but remember that sunshine is always there waiting to peek through. You're brave and strong, and I hope this painting brings you some of that sunshine feeling!

title: Sparkle Eyes
description: A sweet and playful painting of a bright-eyed face, filled with colorful details, rosy cheeks, and sparkling stars that bring a feeling of joy and wonder
warmWords: I painted these sparkling eyes to remind you that there is always something beautiful to look forward to! Even on hard days, your smile and your courage can shine like little stars. Keep being brave, keep dreaming, and never forget how special you are!

title: Dream Garden
description: A watercolor piece inspired by peaceful gardens and happy memories.
warmWords: I created this garden just for you! Gardens are magical places where flowers grow and dreams come true. I hope this painting helps you feel peaceful and happy, like you're in your own special garden full of love.

title: Bow of Love
description: A cute and cheerful painting featuring a sweet character surrounded by bright red bows and tiny hearts, celebrating happiness, friendship, and love.
warmWords: I filled this painting with little hearts and bows just for you! Each heart is a reminder that you are surrounded by love and people who care about you. Keep smiling, stay strong, and remember that you make the world a brighter and happier place!

title: Star Wishes
description: A dreamy night sky filled with stars and wishes for healing.
warmWords: Look up at the stars and make a wish! I painted this sky full of stars because I believe in wishes coming true. You're a star too - bright, beautiful, and full of magic. Keep shining!
